V1_obligation_assessment.evidence: query_logit_cotangents is separately compared with gradient=True and its maximum discrepancy is added to the derivative ledger. The value-comparison loop retains virtual_query_loss, query_logits and adapted. The original derivative and value tolerance values are unchanged.

V1_obligation_assessment.remaining_component: An exception from native_checks() finalization can become the incoming body exception of run(), replacing the designated original native numerical failure. The original may remain in the Python traceback chain, which is weaker than separate primary-error and cleanup-error custody.
remedied_components: run() now stores resources() into whole_child_resources after cleanup and separately records collection exceptions.
terminal_resources() takes fresh elapsed/RSS/CUDA observations, preserves earlier whole-child CUDA maxima, records independent sampling errors and records every observed fixed cap breach.
Each process restoration/source/gate/module-unload operation is attempted through a recording wrapper; errors do not skip later bookkeeping.
run() captures its incoming body exception and rethrows it, while recording independent cleanup/resource/receipt errors.
main() unconditionally resamples terminal resources after success or failure, including early run setup failure, and changes status/code to FAIL on collection errors or cap breaches.
Successful run return requires no restoration, terminal resource, cap or cleanup receipt errors.

findings.consequence: The designated original numerical/native failure is replaced by a cleanup failure. B can still appear as Python exception context in the traceback, but it is not retained as the primary native-body failure, and a native restoration or receipt error has no independent native-finalization ledger. A restoration exception can also prevent attempting the native receipt save. The process remains a failure; this defect does not establish a PASS bypass.
findings.evidence: native_checks() ends with finally: attempted_native_work=calls; native_and_caller_restoration=unchanged(); save(). No native-body exception is designated before that finally, and unchanged()/save() are not caught and recorded independently there. If the native body raises B and either finalizer operation raises C, C propagates into run(), whose qualification_body_error and the main primary error fields then describe C.
findings.predecessor_handling: Preserve the sealed V2 and prepare a disabled V3 successor.
findings.required_scope: Minimal native-body/native-finalization error custody only; no numerical or optional refactoring change.
findings.smallest_remedy: In native_checks(), designate and record the body error before rethrowing it. Attempt unchanged() and receipt save independently, recording native restoration and native receipt-finalization errors separately. Preserve and rethrow the original native-body exception when present; if only native cleanup fails, fail after recording the errors. Keep the numerical body, callbacks, oracles, equations, tolerance values, caps, pins and gates unchanged.
findings.title: Preserve the original native-body failure across native finalization

review_scope: Narrow independent sealed V2 versus preserved V1 source delta: the two V1 correction obligations, primary/independent error custody, unchanged source pins/science/tolerance values/caps/callback accounting, and success-path enforcement.
source_only_conclusion: V2 remedies the query-logit cotangent tolerance and terminal resource/cap recording defects. Process-level body errors, restoration errors and resource-sampling errors are separately recorded. One native_checks finalization path still replaces the designated original native-body error before the process handler sees it, so the failure-preservation part of the second obligation is incomplete. No accidental PASS bypass was identified in the handled source paths; this review is not numerical or runtime qualification.

success_and_failure_path_assessment.body_failure_enforcement: Caught process-body errors are rethrown; the main handler sets FAIL. Native-finalization masking changes which error is designated, not the failure status.
success_and_failure_path_assessment.main_success_enforcement: PASS and code=0 are assigned only after run() returns. The unconditional main terminal sample changes status/code to FAIL for sampling errors or cap breaches. Process restoration/cleanup-only failures raise before run() can return successfully.
success_and_failure_path_assessment.run_success_enforcement: V2 replaces the old successful tail limits() call with fresh terminal resource recording and explicit no-error/no-cap-breach requirements in cleanup. Existing in-body limits() calls and their fixed comparisons are unchanged.
success_and_failure_path_assessment.scope: Static control-flow assessment of handled paths only; no injected or actual failures were executed.
